content:
[11.2-11.6 | Phonics, Wednesday (Session 27)] read words with final e and the endings -ed and -ing.
[11.2-11.6 | Phonics, Thursday (Session 28)] read and write words with str-, spl-, spr-, scr-, shr-, and thr-. / read words that show ownership.
[11.2-11.6 | Phonics, Friday (Session 29 & 30)] Today I will use phonics patterns to read and write long a words, open syllables, and super words.
[11.2-11.6 | Reading, Monday (Session 26), Retrieval] Using because to link an opinion and reason
[11.2-11.6 | Math, Unit 2: Lesson 9] choose whether to add or subtract to solve a word problem.
[11.2-11.6 | SS, Unit 2: Our Georgia (Comparing Georgia's Regions)] SS2G1.b Locate on a physical map the major rivers: Savannah, Flint, and Chattahoochee.
[11.2-11.6 | SS, Monday] Lesson: Appalachian Plateau & Ridge and Valley
[11.2-11.6 | SS, Wednesday] Lesson: Blue Ridge
[11.2-11.6 | SS, Thursday] Lesson: Piedmont
[11.2-11.6 | SS, Thursday, Retrieval (Two Truths and a Lie)] The Blue Ridge is the highest point. 2. The Coastal Plain is the largest region.
[11.2-11.6 | SS, Friday] Lesson: Coastal Plain
